import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0058 (l : List Nat) : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x ≤ l.head) l) ≤ List.length l := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0058 (l : List Nat) : List.length (List.filter (fun x => x ≤ l.head) l) ≤ List.length l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp trivial
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : x ≤ l.head := le_refl x
    have h2 : List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) (List.nil) = List.nil := trivial
    have h3 : List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) (xs ++ List.nil) = List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) xs := trivial
    have h4 : List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) xs ≤ List.length xs := trivial
      simp [List.filter_le_length]
    have h5 : List.length (xs ++ List.nil) = List.length xs := trivial
    have h6 : List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) (l ++ List.nil) = List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) l := trivial
    have h7 : List.length (List.filter (fun y => y ≤ x) l) ≤ List.length l := trivial
      simp [ih, h5, h6]
    exact h7
END BY.
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0058 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0058 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0058

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0058
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0058
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
